ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels; high-intensity pixels dominate the outer lobes while low-intensity pixels are concentrated in the central region and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forming a broad 'V' shape extending from the notch; high-frequency salt-and-pepper mottling at the transition zones between the dark center and white lateral lobes; distinct isolated dark circular spots on the lower-left and mid-right white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees and a defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of jagged peaks and shallow valleys across the entire visible span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, tapering towards the distal tips with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites or scars) scattered across the high-intensity white surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical dark linear streaks visible on the mid-left lobe, intersecting the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-tan pigmentation patches (potential biological staining) located on the mid-right lobe and the lower-left proximal surface; several dark punctate markings on the white fields.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct yellowish discoloration pattern on the right lobe, forming an irregular contiguous geometric shape distinct from the black/white pigmentation.
